technical.summary: Strong technical confluence with multiple bullish crossovers and price above all major MAs, but weak ADX trend strength and overbought stochastics create pullback risk; moderate swing entry with caution on position sizing.

fundamental.summary: LMT shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contract wins, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 98 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear sentiment presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is minimal and mixed with no conviction signal from senior members.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (327), strong dollar pressures multinational earnings, and earnings event in 98 days adds binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong technical confluence with 6 bullish signals (MACD crossover, Stoch bullish cross, Supertrend, Ichimoku TK cross, volume spike 3x, price above all major MAs) and extreme fear sentiment creates contrarian entry opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Weak ADX (15.58) indicates trend strength is fragile, overbought StochRSI signals pullback risk, zero fundamental support (no insider activity, no smart money alignment), severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar), and earnings binary event in 98 days create unacceptable risk/reward for swing trade.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows strong confluence (6 bullish signals, price above all MAs) and extreme fear sentiment creates contrarian opportunity. However, weak ADX trend strength, overbought StochRSI, and severe macro headwinds make risk/reward unfavorable for swing trade execution.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve + VIX crisis + earnings binary event in 98 days create compounding macro and event risk that outweighs technical setup; weak trend strength (ADX 15.58) suggests momentum may not sustain.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical agents bullish but fundamental, risk, and debate agents strongly bearish; macro environment overrides technical signals
decision.portfolio_note: Already 22 positions in Industrials sector; adding LMT increases concentration risk without fundamental conviction or smart money support.
